editorial:
Imagine being stuck in a city that is falling apart around you while the bad guys are closing in. That is exactly where you land with this movie. You follow Commander Mohamed Bida and his team as they try to protect the French embassy in Kabul. It feels like a race against time because they have 500 scared people to protect and no one coming to save them. The vibe is super tense from the start, making you feel the panic of the crowds and the fear of being left behind by your own government. It is a wild ride that puts you right in the middle of the chaos.

The action is top-notch and the pacing never lets up, which keeps you glued to your seat. The acting feels real, especially when the team has to make impossible choices to save lives. While some parts might feel a bit too loud, the stakes make it worth it. If you love high-stakes thrillers, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a nail-biting dash to the airport. After fighting through the streets and dodging traps, Bida and his team manage to get most of the refugees onto the final planes. There is a sad twist where some brave soldiers stay behind to hold the line, sacrificing themselves so others can fly to safety. It wraps up with a heavy feeling of loss but a small win for the people who escaped.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival stories and military thrillers.
